items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you know Mable too? [INTERVIEWEE] Huh? ... [INTERVIEWER] Mable John? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: No, this was Big John. Little Willy John, I knew him, too. He actually grew up in an orphanage too. Would you believe that he grew up in a Jewish orphanage? He spoke Yiddish.
